'''Tazzik''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served a member of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Tazzik and a number of other Brotherhood members joined a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned cell on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], and they schemed to blow up a Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that was docked with the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[New Dawn (space station)|''New Dawn'']] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Druckenwell. Tazzik and fellow Rodian [[Denma]] acted as the functional leaders of the crew of pirates that were to carry out the attack, and they planned to fly to the space station aboard the stolen [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[First Light (freighter)|''First Light'']], then take control of the assault ship and record a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] of the vessel's destruction, to broadcast to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, when Tazzik and the rest of the pirates took off from Druckenwell in the ''First Light'' to initiate their raid, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] stowed away aboard the ship. The agents then attacked Tazzik and the rest of the crew, preventing them from destroying the ''Acclamator'' assault ship.
